ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows five discs, and the problem states that all five discs are of different sizes. Anna must choose exactly 4 of the 5 discs to build a tower. method.method_draft: Read the discs as five distinct sizes. Build the tower by considering which disc is the largest disc in the 4-disc tower. If the largest disc is the biggest one, then choose any 3 of the other 4 smaller discs, giving 4 ways. If the largest disc is the second-biggest one, then all 3 smaller discs must be used, giving 1 way. Smaller discs cannot be the largest of a 4-disc tower because there would not be enough smaller discs to put above them. Total: 4 + 1 = 5.
